title: Understanding Regularization
text: Regularization is a technique used to prevent overfitting by adding a penalty to the model's complexity. It helps in simplifying the model and improving its generalization to new data.

title: L1 vs L2 Regularization
text: L1 regularization, also known as Lasso, tends to produce sparse models by driving some coefficients to zero. L2 regularization, or Ridge, tends to shrink coefficients but usually keeps them non-zero. Consider which might be more beneficial given the problem's context.

title: High Dimensionality and Sparsity
text: In high-dimensional spaces, many features might not contribute significantly to the model's prediction. Think about how L1 regularization can help in selecting only the most important features by setting others to zero.
